programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Benham's Haunted Hospital
programme.desc: The TCC team investigates an old abandoned hospital in Benham, Kentucky. The hospital was built in 1922 and has now been shut down for many years. The building now belongs to the city. Over its years in operation, it was the central hospital for the area. It treated everything from common colds to gunshot wounds. After it closed, numerous stories were told about the location. One story was of a worker being scared so badly that he ran out of the building and refused to go back in. Thomas and Tony visit the hospital in an attempt to document some of the activity.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Making New Year’s resolutions is easy; the hard part is keeping them. Over 90 percent of people give up before ever reaching their goal. Dr. Phil says there's no better time than now to make a change in your life and start creating what you want instead of settling for what you don’t. Learn his five powerful secrets to success in making your resolutions a reality. He shares the stories of three couples with three very different problems they resolve to fix in the New Year. Allyson and James resolve to improve their financial picture, get out of debt and stop living hand-to-mouth. Next, Missy is making one of the most popular resolutions: to lose weight in the New Year. Will she meet her goal in time for her wedding to Justin? Then, Jill and Matt are busy parents whose sex life has gone from fireworks to fizzled out. Their resolution is to reignite the flames and have more sex. Plus, Jim Cramer, author and host of CNBC’s Mad Money, offers a solid strategy for achieving financial resolutions in 2009. This is practical advice you won’t want to miss, whether your income is meager or in the millions. Don’t just make resolutions this year. Tune in to learn how to keep them!

"I know you have the love in your heart," says Dr. Phil. "Family First is the plan to live the love you feel and create a healthy and nurturing family.".

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This is a true crime saga like no other. The Murdaugh family is one of the most prominent families in South Carolina and has served in powerful legal positions dating back nearly 100 years. Rumors swirled that Alex Murdaugh and his family could get away with anything. They have been tied to the mysterious deaths of their housekeeper, a high school classmate, and a young woman in a fatal boat crash. In June 2021, Murdaugh allegedly found his wife and younger son shot dead on their hunting lodge property. About a year later, Murdaugh was charged for their murders. The killings set off a bizarre chain of events that included Murdaugh staging his own murder. There are also nearly 100 financial crimes that are linked to him. Dr. Phil is joined by a panel of experts: former criminal prosecutor Loni Coombs; Michal Higdon, anchor and investigative reporter at WCSC-TV Charleston; forensic expert Joseph Scott Morgan; and former FBI agent Bobby Chacon to discuss this case.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.sub-title: I Was Acquitted, My Ex Says Guilty
programme.desc: A woman confronts accusations of her involvement in her son's accidental overdose.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These moms are sick and tired of living a lie. One mom fears her secret addiction to pain killers will tear her family apart. She asks Dr. Phil to help her get off the drugs before she loses everything, including her unborn child! Also, a grandmother who steals everything from steaks to ceiling fans. She says she knows it’s wrong and wants to stop, but is she really just afraid of getting caught? Plus, a mother confesses to her daughter a secret she has been carrying for 29 years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine meeting the man of your dreams. He’s your Prince Charming and completely sweeps you off your feet. But there’s a small problem; you’ve only known him three weeks -- and you’re already married! Dr. Phil speaks with Stephanie, who’s in the middle of a complicated love triangle with her husband, Robert, and the man she claims to love, Richard. Robert is desperate to save his marriage, even though this isn’t his wife’s first affair. Stephanie admits she has a constant need for male attention that may have stemmed from her childhood. What is at the root of her philandering ways? And, hear why Richard believes he’s done nothing wrong. Is Stephanie being totally honest to her current love interest, or is he doomed to fail with her as well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Black Rhino"
programme.desc: Classified as critically endangered, these animals are known for their unpredictable and aggressive behaviour when approached or caught unaware. Join the capture team in an adventurous capture exercise at the Hluhluwe-Imfolozi Park.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Tiny Diving Antelope"

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Gentle Giants"
programme.desc: For this episode we will travel to the Entabeni Safari Conservancy where a special family of African elephant awaits relocation. The family will be moved from a private conservation area as they have reached the carrying capacity of that area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Impala"
programme.desc: With a high reproduction rate that leads to large numbers on reserves and are the staple diet for predators that keep their numbers in check. See how these highly adapted and unique animals get loaded and gently treated to “migrate” to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "White Rhino"
programme.desc: Another member of Africa’s Big 5 - the white rhino. Once on the brink of extinction, and today thanks to the conservation and breeding strategies, there are enough to relocate to other nature reserves to ensure the survival of this unique species.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Plains Game"
programme.desc: The technique to capture wildebeest and zebra involves an experienced team, a helicopter and favourable weather conditions! The helicopter pilot drives the herd straight into the funnel, directly into the vehicles...and on their way to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Giraffe"
programme.desc: When the animal you need to capture has a very long neck and standing almost 5 meters high, and able to spot you a mile away, you need to adapt your strategy dramatically.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Hoggs, Hippos & Hyraxes"
programme.desc: The capture team is busy in Ithala Game Reserve where several warthogs need new pastures. Meanwhile an interesting small animal, called a “dassie’ or rock hyrax is lured into traps as they are becoming a menace in the Ntshondwe camp area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Bushbuck & Buffalo"
programme.desc: Being one of Africa’s Big 5, the Buffalo is an animal that requires a well-experienced team to capture and load. Bushbuck on the other hand proves to be much easier to capture...

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Season’s End"
programme.desc: In this episode of Modern Migrations we’ve reached the end of the capture season. However, before we reflect on the seasons’ high’s and low’s it is history in the making when we will attempt to relocate a black rhino cow AND her calf simultaneously!

programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Busqueda De La Piedra Magica
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer….

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting

But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: Love’s Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Amor Idéntico

Pero sus planes de escapar se frustran cuando se encuentra con el hermano gemelo de su ex prometido, Seth (un dentista), que también trabaja como voluntario en la clínica. Mientras pasan tiempo juntos, Seth se enamora de Charlotte, pero ella lucha por dejar de ver a su prometido cada vez que mira a Seth. El romance isleño la ayudará a liberarse del pasado y amar a Seth por quien es.

Alquilandole una habitación al dueño de una posada, Adam, Winona acepta cocinar en el Festival de Primavera mientras reparan su auto… y pronto descubre su amor por el pueblo… y por cierto residente en particular.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem adulto não para de gritar, uma jovem mãe está alerta, mas com frio e um jovem parece ter uma overdose de drogas, mas ele nega. Todos esses casos são mistérios médicos que exigem soluções de salvamento inovadoras e “fora da caixa”.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um tornado devastador causa destruição em Oklahoma e o hospital é o centro para vítimas com ferimentos. Um paciente severamente ferido chega à emergência e o cirurgião de plantão, o Dr. Mauricio Heilbron Sr., o leva às pressas para uma cirurgia.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma ciclista está com múltiplos ferimentos e seu namorado está tendo desmaios. A perna de um homem fica severamente ferida quando ele é atropelado por um trem. Um solteiro bêbado ajuda a descobrir o segredo de uma enfermeira misteriosa.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O especialista em picadas de cobra, o Dr. Sean Bush, encara um pesadelo: a sua esposa liga para ele dizendo que uma cascavel picou o filho deles de dois anos de idade. O Dr. Dee L’Archeveque trata de um homem com uma bola de golfe empalada na cabeça.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Dois pacientes dão entrada na emergência, ambos com convulsões. O pulmão de um idoso para de funcionar e sua jovem esposa e filha brigam por ele. Uma dançarina de dança do ventre desmaia em um bar e os médicos têm que descobrir o porquê.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um caubói desorientado está encharcado de suor, salivando e urinando em excesso, ninguém sabe por quê. Uma haste de metal está empalada na cabeça de uma jovem. Duas adolescentes estão com falta de ar, o que andaram fazendo?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Os médicos lutam para salvar um jovem levado à emergência congelado em sem pulso. Um homem fica fatalmente doente na sua festa de aniversário. Um segredo vergonhoso impede que um paciente corra para a sala de cirurgia para ser operado.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um médico precisa tomar uma difícil decisão se reanima ou não um paciente idoso com uma parada cardiorrespiratória. Duas enfermeiras encontram uma vítima de esfaqueamento na rua. Uma médica em um cruzeiro descobre que a sua viagem se tornou um pesadelo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem tem um choque anafilático. Um cara forte tem medo de agulha. Um homem se esfaqueia com uma espada ninja. Um paciente precisa de exorcismo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um paciente psiquiátrico tem uma paixão extrema por pudim de chocolate. Um paciente em choque anafilático pode ser alérgico à sua namorada. Um homem que está com o rosto bizarramente inchado precisa ser convencido a se tratar.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Na véspera de Natal, um homem vestido de Papai Noel está à beira da morte e a sua esposa pede um favor especial ao médico: coletar o sêmen de seu marido. Um homem não consegue respirar porque um peixe vivo está preso em sua garganta.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um garoto de seis anos sofre um derrame que ameaça a sua vida. Um homem está com um fogão de acampamento preso em seu pênis. Um jovem médico da emergência fica preocupado quando lhe pedem para verificar a saúde da esposa de outro médico.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: A Dra. Alexandra Dresel é testada quando uma vítima de assalto chega à emergência com duas balas no cérebro. O Dr. Mauricio Heilbron Jr. precisa testar seu autocontrole quando recebe dois casos complicados.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quando um bebê aparentemente saudável desenvolve repentinamente deficiência de oxigênio, a Dra. Beth Schissel encara um mistério médico. Quando a polícia leva ao hospital um homem desarrumado, a Dra. Kivela acha que há algum segredo sobre ele.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O Ecstasy e a Agonia. Doido Nu Esfaqueia Vítima. Salvando Duas Trompas. Árvore no Pescoço.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond, Willis e Arnold dominam bravamente um ladrão que mantinha a família sob a mira de uma arma, mas o policial que o prende fica confuso quando os três "combatentes do crime" relatam versões diferentes da apreensão.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold e Dudley sucumbem à pressão dos colegas e ignoram os avisos contra o tabagismo, mas o pai de Dudley, um fumante crônico, mostra a eles a dura realidade do tabagismo.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O primeiro dia de Arnold no segundo Ensino Fundamental II é emocionalmente devastador quando ele é evitado por não corresponder às expectativas que todos tinham para o irmão de Willis Jackson.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O descaso aparentemente inofensivo de Willis pela verdade se torna perigoso quando uma mentira egoísta sobre saber reanimação cardiorrespiratória coloca em risco a vida de Arnold.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O presente de aniversário de 18 anos que Kimberly ganha do pai - uma poupança - fará dela uma mulher rica, mas seus sonhos de independência podem ser interrompidos quando o Sr. Drummond descobrir exatamente como ela pretende gastar sua "fortuna".

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O êxtase de Arnold ao conhecer seu herói, o Mr. T, vai da alegria à tristeza quando a jovem que ele está tentando impressionar o despreza em favor de seu ídolo.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold transforma um amigo em oponente quando renuncia ao cargo de gerente de campanha de Dudley e declara sua própria candidatura a presidente da turma.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold, de 13 anos, é convocado para o serviço militar, a reação exagerada do Sr. Drummond ao erro óbvio, transforma os sonhos de Arnold em pesadelos.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma breve visita de Ann, a prima holandesa de Phillip Drummond, e o filho dela, Hans, aos Estados Unidos, se torna uma eternidade para Arnold e Willis, que se tornam bodes expiatórios para as travessuras do primo Hans.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Drummond recebe proteção policial de um tipo incomum depois que suas atividades filantrópicas levam a uma ameaça de extorsão de um milhão de dólares contra ele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold fica desapontado ao descobrir que sua professora favorita trabalha como garçonete numa boate, mas fica surpreso quando descobre por que ela precisa de um segundo emprego.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O jovem amor de Willis e Charlene começa a murchar quando ela se muda para a casa de Drummond como hóspede temporária. Janet Jackson, irmã mais nova de Michael Jackson, retorna em seu papel como a namorada de Willis, Charlene.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Kimberly inicia uma campanha para abrir a atlética da escola para membros femininos, Willis, envergonhado, retalia com desenvoltura chauvinista, tornando-se o primeiro competidor masculino no Concurso de Beleza das Alunas do Último Ano.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Cega de amor, Kimberly assume um risco enorme e enganoso quando convence seu pai a permitir que ela se mude para um apartamento, supostamente com sua amiga.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond tenta fazer um acordo de negócios com a instrutora de ginástica Maggie McKinney e se apaixona por ela.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold e Kimberly pegam carona para chegar em casa para a festa de aniversário do Sr. Drummond e são apanhados por um homem que os leva para seu apartamento e tenta abusar sexualmente de Kimberly.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Depois que Kimberly e Arnold são sequestrados ao pegarem carona, Arnold consegue escapar. No entanto, ele está tão desorientado que não consegue descobrir onde está.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond viaja para Hollywood e pede Maggie em casamento e descobre que ela tem um filho chamado Sam. Enquanto isso, Arnold e Dudley tentam conhecer a estrela de A Super Máquina e entram em um carro no set que está prestes a explodir.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: David Hasselhoff resgata Arnold e Dudley bem a tempo, e o resto da família descobre os planos de casamento do Sr. Drummond. Arnold não fica nem um pouco feliz, especialmente quando descobre que vai ganhar um novo irmãozinho como parte do acordo.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Com a família e os amigos reunidos, Phillip e Maggie se encontram no altar, mas percebem que cada um cometeu um grande erro, na parte final de uma história especial de duas partes.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold e Pearl caem em depressão quando Maggie e Phillip retornam de sua lua de mel e dispensam Pearl temporariamente do serviço, e ordenam que Arnold cuide de seu irmãozinho Sam em vez de ir à uma festa.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Na busca por uma religião, iniciada por Maggie e seu pai, Arnold acha que a encontrou depois de participar de um impressionante bar mitzvah, onde seu amigo "se torna um homem" aos 13 anos.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O dinheiro que a turma de Arnold arrecadou e deixou aos cuidados dele para os Jogos Nacionais de Cadeira de Rodas desapareceu, deixando Arnold constrangido e a família deprimida.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O lar dos Drummond encara o problema de Sam em fazer xixi na cama, tentando de tudo: Desde a repreensão até a adulação, mas apenas causando mais frustração e dor em Sam.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Drummond é acusado de não ser cortês com seus empregados, ele aceita secretamente um trabalho em uma de suas próprias indústrias, na área de linha de montagem.

programme.desc: Uma gangue de Chicago pensou que havia descoberto como sequestrar pessoas por resgate repetidamente e nunca serem descobertos. O único erro deles foi subestimar o FBI.

programme.title: Os Arquivos do FBI
programme.desc: Da Califórnia a Kentucky, poucos que moravam perto de uma ferrovia pareciam seguros no verão de 1999. Um serial killer, seguiu pelos trilhos escolhendo cidades e vítimas aleatoriamente.

programme.title: Os Arquivos do FBI

programme.title: Os Arquivos do FBI
programme.desc: Em uma pequena comunidade de Ohio, uma mulher idosa e um menino adolescente desapareceram. Como eles desapareceram com pouco tempo de diferença entre os acontecimentos, a polícia acreditava que os casos estavam ligados, mas não sabiam como.

programme.title: Os Arquivos do FBI
programme.desc: Um corpo carbonizado em um beco escuro pôs em evidência um assassino de sangue frio. Seus parceiros no crime contariam a história, se eles sobrevivessem. No submundo do comércio de drogas, mesmo um amigo de infância pode rapidamente se tornar um inimigo.

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações
programme.desc: Três adolescentes, sem muito o que fazer na pequena cidade de Green Lake, Wisconsin, decidem passar a noite de Halloween no supostamente mal-assombrado Cemitério de Dartford.

programme.title: Assombrações
programme.desc: O fantasma de um racista assombra a casa de um guitarrista de jazz e toma posse de seu filho.

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações
programme.desc: O dono de um salão de dança de música country fica preocupado quando sua esposa grávida culpa um fantasma por uma queda perigosa e seu faz-tudo exibe sinais de possessão demoníaca.

programme.title: Assombrações
programme.desc: Em Tucson, Arizona, uma mãe e esposa compram e reformam uma casa abandonada. Mais tarde, como avó, ela descobre que uma entidade na casa representa uma ameaça terrível para seu jovem neto.

programme.title: Assombrações
programme.desc: O namorado de Cindy Sarro, Jake, surpreende ela e suas duas filhas com uma nova casa. Parece perfeito até que ela sente a presença de um demônio que possui Jake, que vem até ela com um machado.

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: iCarly: O beijo
programme.desc: Quando Sam revela sem querer a Carly que ela e Freddie se beijaram, Carly se ofende por eles não terem contado a ela antes. Enquanto isso, Spencer ensina arte a detentos.

programme.title: iCarly: Cozinhando com o iCarly
programme.desc: Depois de Carly, Sam e Freddie derrotarem um famoso chef da televisão em um concurso de cozinha, o chef desiste de cozinhar, cancela seu programa e se recusa sair de seu quarto. Enquanto isso, Spencer trata de realizar sua visão do futuro.

programme.title: iCarly: Sob nova direção
programme.desc: Quando Carly, Sam e Freddie acidentalmente fazem com que o diretor Franklin seja demitido, Miss Briggs e Mr. Howard assumem o controle da diretoria da escola e impõem duras regras.

programme.title: iCarly: Encontro a jato
programme.desc: Tantos meninos aparecem para o concurso "Tire a Carly para Dançar", que a turma precisa armar um encontro a jato com todos.

programme.title: iCarly: O retorno da diva
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Fred querem fazer um vídeo musical que marque o grande retorno de um astro pop, mas descobrem que o músico está fora de forma e sem talento.

programme.title: iCarly: O salvamento
programme.desc: Quando Freddie salva a vida de Carly, ela termina se apaixonando por ele. Enquanto isso, Sam e Spencer competem entre si num jogo de paintball chamado “Assassin”.

programme.title: iCarly: Eu desisto Parte 1
programme.desc: Quando a equipe de iCarly apresenta dois novos comediantes da internet, Fleck e Dave, no seu programa, eles precisam que o próximo vídeo dos garotos seja uma grande sucesso.

programme.title: iCarly: Eu desisto Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly e Sam rapidamente entendem que sua briga está acabando com o programa web. Seria esse o fim de iCarly? Enquanto isso, Spencer precisa defender seu barco de um estudante universitário muito irritado.

programme.title: iCarly: O amor perdido de Lewbert
programme.desc: Quando a turma descobre que Lewbert foi um jovem feliz e noivo de uma linda mulher, eles tentam reaproximar os noivos.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam e os concursos de beleza
programme.sub-title: Sam e os concursos de beleza
programme.desc: Sam confessa um segredo a seus amigos Carly e Freddie: ela competia em concursos de beleza quando era pequena. A garota convence Carly a competir contra uma velha rival dela.

programme.title: iCarly: Cancelar nem pensar
programme.desc: Quando Sam acaba na prisão, Carly e Freedie concordam que devem continuar com o programa, já que é a primeira vez que o pai de Carly verá o show.

programme.title: iCarly: A viagem espacial
programme.desc: Um bilionário propõe que iCarly seja o primeiro webshow transmitido do espaço. Assim, a turma passa por testes para uma viagem espacial.

programme.title: iCarly: Saindo de casa
programme.desc: Cansado de sua mãe sempre tratá-lo como um bebê, Freddie decide sair de casa. Enquanto isso, a turma inicia um negócio com fotografia de animais de estimação.

programme.title: iCarly: O apagão
programme.desc: Quando uma onda de calor invade Seattle e a luz acaba, Spencer chega com um inovador sistema de ar condicionado. Assim, todos os habitantes do edifício se veem obrigados a pedir asilo no apartamento de Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Uma louca aventura Parte 1
programme.desc: Enquanto Carly está revisando os vídeos enviados pelos fãs, ela encontra o material de uma garota que está de aniversário e que diz que seu melhor presente seria ter seus ídolos do iCarly em sua festa.

programme.title: iCarly: Uma louca aventura Parte 2
programme.desc: Enquanto Carly está revisando os vídeos enviados pelos fãs, ela encontra o material de uma garota que está de aniversário e que diz que seu melhor presente seria ter seus ídolos do iCarly em sua festa.

programme.title: iCarly: Todos erram
programme.desc: Miranda Cosgrove se reúne juntamente com Jerry Trainor para ver os vídeos dos erros de gravação do programa.

programme.title: iCarly: O quarto novo
programme.desc: Chega o aniversário de Carly e Spencer quer impressiona-la com uma lâmpada de ursinhos de gelatina que ele instala no quarto de sua irmã. O problema é que acontece um curto-circuito e o quarto de Carly acaba incendiando!

programme.title: iCarly: O dia do sim
programme.desc: Depois que um fã de iCarly pede sua namorada em casamento ao vivo no programa, a turma é convidada para a cerimônia. Mas as coisas começam a desandar quando a noiva decide que quer se casar com Spencer!

programme.title: iCarly: Vendendo camisetas
programme.desc: A turma de iCarly decide empreender um novo negócio, produzindo e vendendo camisetas baratas. Depois que as vendas são um sucesso, Sam recruta crianças da quarta série para produzir as camisetas.

programme.title: iCarly: As pegadinhas
programme.desc: Ridicularizada por nunca pregar peças em ninguém, Carly pede a Spencer que ele a ajude a fazer uma brincadeira com Sam e Freddie. O problema é que, depois da primeira brincadeira, Spencer não consegue mais parar de pregar peças.

programme.title: iCarly: A mãe da Sam
programme.desc: Sam vai morar com Carly e Spencer depois de brigar com sua mãe, Pam. Carly, cansada dos hábitos inconvenientes de sua amiga, decide fazer com que Sam e sua mãe se reconciliem levando as duas para ver um terapeuta familiar.

programme.title: iCarly: Que peninha do Nevel
programme.desc: Quando um vídeo de Nevel gritando com uma criança cai na internet, ele começa a ser odiado por todos. Nevel implora pela ajuda de Sam, Carly e Freedie, que se unem para reconstruir a honra do garoto.

programme.title: iCarly: Eu contratei um mané
programme.desc: A turma decide contratar um estagiário para as séries. Carly e Sam contratam um garoto que acham bonito, mas ele acaba trazendo mais problemas do que ajuda.

programme.title: iCarly: A guerra dos fãs Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vão a uma convenção que reúne celebridades da internet para se reunirem com seus fãs. Mas, acidentalmente, eles começam uma guerra entre os fãs de iCarly. Enquanto isso, Spencer enfrenta seu inimigo de jogos online.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Ambição Rumo ao Vearth Sem Fim! A Arca Maxim!
programme.desc: O Deus Enel se recupera incrivelmente das feridas que deveriam colocar fim ao seu reinado de terror. Zoro e Wyper unem forças para uma investida final, e Nami deve escolher entre seus companheiros e sua própria sobrevivência.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enfim, o Confronto! O Pirata Luffy vs. O Deus Enel!
programme.desc: Luffy escapa da serpente e, diante do que aconteceu nas ruínas, só pensa em vingança! O Chapéu de Palha avança para confrontar Enel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Enquanto os cidadãos do céu fogem, Enel conjura Deathpiea! Luffy está determinado a deter o tirano, mas primeiro precisa descobrir como pôr as mãos em Deus!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Queda de Luffy! O Julgamento de Deus e o Desejo de Nami!
programme.desc: Um punhado de ouro pode ser a ruína de Luffy, Sanji e Usopp formam um time de resgate aéreo e Nami se prepara para um confronto eletrizante contra o Deus Enel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Os Dois Despertam! Na Linha de Frente do Resgate do Amor Incandescente!
programme.desc: Usopp e Sanji embarcam a Arca Maxim para salvar Nami, e o pirata mentiroso chega bem a tempo de impedir que a gatuna seja dilacerada por um ataque do Deus Enel! Enquanto isso, onde foi parar o cozinheiro?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Capricho para o Desespero! A Iminente Destruição das Ilhas do Céu!
programme.desc: Apesar do globo de ouro que o prende, Luffy sobe o pé de feijão gigante para acertar as contas com Enel, enquanto o povo da ilha encara a cólera de Deus!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Guiados pelo Som de um Sino! O Conto do Grande Guerreiro e do Explorador!
programme.desc: Um vislumbre das vidas de duas lendas da história de Skypiea - Montblanc Noland e o Grande Guerreiro Calgara!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Livre da Maldição! O Grande Guerreiro Verte Lágrimas!
programme.desc: A saga de Montblanc Noland e Calgara segue com a história de como dois homens tão distintos desenvolveram sua amizade tão rapidamente quanto a perderam!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Amigos Para Sempre! O Sino da Promessa Ecoa Pelos Mares!
programme.desc: Montblanc Noland e Calgara conseguem superar suas diferenças antes de dizerem adeus, mas outras forças conspiram para separá-los para sempre!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Ilha dos Anjos Obliterada! O Horror do Advento do Trovão!
programme.desc: Enel devasta a Ilha dos Anjos com um trovão obliterador e Luffy continua sua escalada heroica no pé de feijão gigante!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Derrubem o João Gigante! A Última Esperança de Fuga!
programme.desc: Nami tem um plano para dar a Luffy mais uma chance na feroz batalha contra Deus. Zoro terá papel principal, mas pode não sobreviver à missão!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Milagre na Terra de Deus! A Canção de Amor que Alcançou os Anjos!
programme.desc: O raciocínio rápido de Nami deixa Luffy mais perto de Deus, e o Chapéu de Palha se lança para o centro de uma sinistra tempestade!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Fim da Batalha! A Orgulhosa Fantasia Ecoa Ao Longe!
programme.desc: Após a batalha épica contra Enel, o sol volta a brilhar sobre a Ilha do Céu e seus cidadãos reconstroem seu lar.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eu Estive Aqui! O Fio Tecido Pelo Poneglifo!
programme.desc: Robin tenta decifrar o enigma de um misterioso poneglifo. Usopp negocia com os locais e Luffy ataca os tesouros inimagináveis da lendária cidade do ouro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: De Volta ao Mar Azul! Despedida Trançada em Sentimentos!
programme.desc: Com uma ajudinha de seus novos amigos, os Chapéus de Palha dizem adeus a Skypiea e seguem novamente para o Mar Azul.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Estado de Emergência! Infiltrados por um Infame Navio Pirata!
programme.desc: A Marinha está convencida de que o Merry é um navio fantasma depois que a embarcação dos Chapéus de Palha cai no forte vinda dos céus. Seus tripulantes, porém, desaparecem.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sanji, o Cozinheiro! Prove Seu Mérito no Refeitório!
programme.desc: Disfarçado, Sanji mostra aos chefs da Marinha, liderados por Jessica, como é que se cozinha uma refeição decente para os soldados famintos.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Zoro Capturado e as Operações de Emergência de Chopper!
programme.desc: Zoro acaba prisioneiro na fortaleza, e Chopper e Nami auxiliam uma nervosa médica que trata dos soldados feridos em combate.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Cerco da Marinha se Fecha! O Segundo Pirata é Capturado!
programme.desc: Robin e Usopp se disfarçam do mesmo inspetor externo da Marinha, e Luffy e Sanji são descobertos por Jonathan.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Os Audaciosos Luffy e Sanji! A Grande Operação de Resgate!
programme.desc: O verdadeiro Shepherd é jogado na cela de Zoro e Usopp, e Luffy e Sanji correm para resgatar seus companheiros antes que sejam também capturados.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Sangue Quente das Forças Especiais! Batalha na Ponte!
programme.desc: Luffy e Sanji, após libertarem Zoro e Usopp, tentam fugir de Navarone. A unidade de elite da Marinha é acionada, e Nami e Chopper chegam às docas.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Quebrando o Cerco! O Going Merry é Recuperado!
programme.desc: O bando se encontra nas docas e acaba cercado pela Marinha. Usando Nami como falsa refém, eles conseguem fazer os inimigos os deixarem subir a bordo do Merry novamente.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Navio Pirata Desaparece! O Segundo Round da Batalha no Forte!
programme.desc: O bando disfarça o Merry de navio da Marinha para que consigam recuperar seu tesouro. Com o ouro, eles decidem que vão contratar um construtor naval.
